mapper.select: SELECT guild_id FROM guild_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND left_at IS NULL ORDER BY joined_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name AS guild_name, COALESCE(m.active_member_count, 0) AS active_member_count, COALESCE(r.recorded_member_date_count, 0) AS recorded_member_date_count, COALESCE(q.quest_total_count, 0) AS quest_total_count, COALESCE(q.quest_completed_count, 0) AS quest_completed_count, COALESCE(bb.total_damage, 0) AS boss_damage, COALESCE(bb.max_hp, 0) AS boss_max_hp, COALESCE(bb.current_hp, 0) AS boss_current_hp, bb.status AS battle_status, b.difficulty AS difficulty FROM guilds g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gm.guild_id, COUNT(1) AS active_member_count FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY gm.guild_id ) m ON m.guild_id = g.guild_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gm.guild_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.user_id, '-', CAST(d.eaten_at AS DATE))) AS recorded_member_date_count FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id JOIN diets d ON d.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CAST(d.eaten_at AS DATE) BETWEEN #{weekStartDate} AND #{weekEndDate} GROUP BY gm.guild_id ) r ON r.guild_id = g.guild_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.guild_id, COUNT(1) AS quest_total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quest_completed_count FROM quests q WHERE CAST(q.created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN #{weekStartDate} AND #{weekEndDate} GROUP BY q.guild_id ) q ON q.guild_id = g.guild_id LEFT JOIN boss_battles bb ON bb.battle_id = ( SELECT bb2.battle_id FROM boss_battles bb2 WHERE bb2.guild_id = g.guild_id AND CAST(bb2.started_at AS DATE) <= #{weekEndDate} ORDER BY CASE WHEN bb2.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, bb2.started_at DESC, bb2.battle_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.guild_id ASC
SELECT boss_id, name AS boss_name, difficulty FROM bosses WHERE boss_id = #{bossId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT bb.guild_id, g.name AS guild_name, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage, bb.started_at, bb.ended_at FROM boss_battles bb JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = bb.guild_id WHERE bb.boss_id = #{bossId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN bb.status = 'DEFEATED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, bb.total_damage DESC, CASE WHEN bb.ended_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bb.ended_at ASC, bb.started_at ASC, bb.guild_id ASC
